description: Today's StockFloc Floc Heat Index, a 0 to 100 daily market-breadth gauge (50 is neutral; above 50 the market ran hot, below 50 it froze), plus how many of the most-traded US stocks are on fire (up 10% or more) versus frozen (down 10% or more). Use this when someone asks how hot or cold the stock market is today, or how many stocks made big moves. US stocks only, delayed about 15 minutes; returns the index and counts, not prices.
name: get_market_heat
title: Get the StockFloc market heat
